Carousel.subtitle: Two complementary profiles, one shared mission: to make learning clearer, more human and more accessible.

founders.name: Simon
founders.bio: In 2017, I volunteered to complete a civic service mission as a digital mediator. My mission was to train staff with disabilities in office software tools. There I discovered a true passion for teaching, which I share with you today.

founders.name: Yasmine
founders.bio: Passionate about languages and intercultural communication, I support learners in mastering French and Spanish. My approach is based on exchange and trust to remove language barriers.

items.q: How do I access the courses?
items.a: Everything is online, free and needs no sign-up: tracks, lessons and cheat sheets are available straight from the site. The PDF sheets and guides download in one click, with no account to create.

items.q: Are the courses suitable for complete beginners?
items.a: Yes, absolutely! Our courses are designed to be accessible to everyone, even people who have never used a computer or learned a foreign language.

items.q: Do I have to follow the tracks in a particular order?
items.a: No, each track stands on its own, so start with the one that concerns you. Within a track the lessons are numbered in a deliberate order, but you are free to open whichever one you need.

items.q: Can I ask questions or get support?
items.a: Yes, write to us through the contact form and we reply within 24 to 48 hours. You can also use the members area to receive the PDF guides as soon as they come out.

items.q: Are the courses available in several languages?
items.a: Yes. The site and all the articles exist in French, English, Spanish and Bulgarian. The language courses additionally let you choose the language the documents are taught in.

hero.title: Who are we?
hero.desc: Two people passionate about teaching and knowledge sharing, united to make learning accessible to everyone.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.p1: At Domaformalis, we believe that everyone deserves to learn, whatever their starting level, age or situation.
mission.p2: Simon and Yasmine form a complementary team: IT & digital on one side, languages & culture on the other.

simon.p1: In 2017, aged 24, Simon completed an 8-month Civic Service mission as a digital mediator in an ESAT. There he trained staff with disabilities to use computer tools and discovered a true passion for teaching.
simon.p2: Since then, he has put that passion at the service of everyone by creating clear, illustrated training courses that are accessible even to complete beginners.

yasmine.p1: Passionate about languages and cultures, Yasmine is Domaformalis' language lead. She designs learning materials for language study, adapted to all levels.
yasmine.p2: Her kind teaching approach and deep knowledge of each language make her the cornerstone of the project's language courses.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.desc: How we collect, use and protect your personal data.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
content: The controller of the data collected on domaformalis.com is:
Simon Beltran, publisher of the site on a personal basis
Contact: contact@domaformalis.com

sections.title: 2. Data collected
content: We only collect data you voluntarily provide:
— Via the contact form: name, email address, subject and message content
— Via a guide request or the newsletter: email address, with your explicit consent (double opt-in)
No data is collected automatically for profiling or advertising purposes.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of processing
content: Your data is used exclusively to reply to your messages, send you the guide you requested, and deliver the newsletter you subscribed to.
Your data is never sold, rented or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
content: Processing is based on your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR). You may withdraw it at any time via the unsubscribe link or by writing to contact@domaformalis.com.

sections.title: 5. Retention periods
content: — Contact data: 12 months from the last exchange
— Newsletter: until you unsubscribe
— Guide requests: 12 months
Beyond these periods, your data is permanently deleted.

sections.title: 6. Recipients and processors
content: Your data is accessible only to the site's publisher.
It is technically processed by our service providers under GDPR-compliant agreements: Vercel Inc. (hosting — privacy policy), Supabase (database) and our email delivery provider.

sections.title: 7. Transfers outside the EU
content: Some providers are based in the United States. These transfers are governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses, in accordance with the GDPR.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
content: The site only uses technical storage required for its operation: language preference (localStorage). No advertising cookies, no tracking tools (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, etc.).
No consent is required for storage strictly necessary to the site's operation.

sections.title: 9. Security
content: We implement appropriate measures to protect your data: secure HTTPS/TLS connection, restricted data access, secure hosting.

sections.title: 10. Your rights (GDPR)
content: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights: access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability and withdrawal of consent at any time.
To exercise these rights: contact@domaformalis.com — reply within 30 days.

sections.title: 11. Supervisory authorities

CNIL (France) — 3 Place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07 — www.cnil.fr
CPDP (Bulgaria) — www.cpdp.bg
